why: int_cells stores raw interception counts (n, w) on a 288-cell grid. League (scope L, id NFL) and team (scope T) rows identify counts, not p_hat_parent. No rate column is present. The EB ladder parent is not stored: the league rung's parent is the external constant INT_BASELINE, and team/QB parents are shrunk rates computed at serve time. Q rows have no team id. season_key is a season (or 2026_w1..w3), not a qb-week, so a single EB cell per qb_id, season, week is not in the file. Not computed.
